name: Automatic Translation Template Discovery
description: Provides functionality to assist with adding custom translations for modules, themes and profiles.

suggests.drupal/potx: Provides a user interface to extract POT files for your custom modules and themes. Usually added as a development requirement.

project_description: Automatic Translation Template Discovery (ATD) is a small helper module that lets custom modules, themes and profiles ship their own interface translations. It implements hook_system_info_alter() so that any extension containing a translations/ directory is automatically registered with an 'interface translation project' and an 'interface translation server pattern' (%project.%language.po). Drupal's locale/interface-translation system then discovers and imports those .po files with drush locale-check / locale-update, without any per-extension configuration.
